content.rationale: The node-set module. It enumerates the node ids from jj — the changes touching `nodes/`, each reported as its change id (D1b), which is the node it owns (S2-set, ryzlzrkk) — through the runner (M-jj, zruxtxrv) rather than the working copy's directory; it reads each node's document through the read interface (S2-read, nqktpzuu) and surfaces every load failure as a value rather than an abort; the caller — log's all-or-nothing read, validate's per-node report — decides what a failure means. It names ids through store_path (vkztyrzm) and loads through node_load (sxonuzmr); D3 (volxoyyy) fixes the edges to report and D4 (mqqwzvwz) that targets are sibling ids with the root excepted, while S2-path (pumpuqkv) fixes the one layout and S2-invalid (uzvzopwp) the failure shape. M-layout (szmuyqrq) places the module flat at src/node_set.rs, and I1-serde (orrvsxqq) fixes the JSON layer it is written against.
